summary: British authorities have thwarted a suspected terrorist plot targeting a military base used by U.S. bombers for strikes on Iran, marking a significant security incident for allied operations. In defense policy, U.S. Northern Command is forging closer ties with Pacific and European commands to bolster security in the Arctic region. In spaceflight engineering, researchers have achieved real-time monitoring inside spacecraft heat shields during extreme heat conditions, while engineers are also utilizing new techniques that teach spacecraft to "dream" their way to autonomous arrivals at the space station. In astrophysics, preliminary research demonstrates that black hole jets extend far beyond the visible edges of galaxies to potentially shape their ultimate evolution, a phenomenon supported by the discovery of a radio galaxy showing evidence of four distinct jet outbursts. Additionally, NASA’s Astronomy Picture of the Day highlighted digital processing by showcasing the Andromeda galaxy before and after image editing. Looking ahead, observers should watch for upcoming operational testing of these advanced autonomous navigation algorithms and heat shield diagnostics on future spaceflight missions.
